briefs.task: Plan the SEA module (docs/plans/SEA/BRIEF.md). The owner, asked whether SEA and CLOUDS planning could start now rather than waiting on their port timing, said (13 Nov 2026): "On 2 use the fable planner like normal but you can bring that across when it makes sense." Lead's reading, to record as an assumption: planning starts now, and the owner leaves to this plan when the Broadsides Rust work is brought across, within docs/design/decisions/SEA-AND-CLOUD-PORT.md (module by module, no wholesale import, Broadsides untouched). Milestones that depend on unfinished modules wait on them as usual.
